data/config/water_dune_cover.json._comment: Owner Lake Michigan dunes direction, 2026-09-28. Default-off local/static visual candidate pending native capture review. Sleeping Bear Dunes NPS photos guide sandy gaps, upright straw/sage grass and sheltered woodland; no photographic pixels or new models. Runtime copies only: source ground-cover/vegetation configs, terrain bake, routes, harvest and collision remain unchanged. Veilfall's static mountain vegetation and authored groves retain their existing treatment.
data/config/water_dune_cover.json._comment_colonies: Unjudged rooted-tussock candidate: pointed ribbons fan out from a shared root with varied arcs, leaf-specific olive/straw gradients and smaller pockets within each colony. Existing terrain and gameplay clearances remain enforced. Source profiles and other realms are unchanged.

ground_cover._comment_colony_shape: Unjudged coverage proposal: independently warped bare gaps cut whole colonies; sparse pioneers soften their margins and extend only onto dry painted shore. A common density ceiling rises from shore probability at 3m to unrestricted colony probability at 6m on all eligible ground, avoiding a painted-boundary density jump. Rock, wet-height, holes and all existing built/anchor/camp clearances remain enforced. No terrain/control-map or geometry changes.

shelter._comment: Canopy and understory share deterministic centres accepted by both original ground/slope/clearance rules. Existing lee bounds remain unchanged. An upwind ridge must rise at least ridge_relief_m above the centre; bounded unsuccessful searches report zero groves with no fallback placement.

data/config/water_dune_terrain.json._comment: Owner-directed Lake Michigan dune islands, 2026-09-28. Presentation-only surface replacement outside Veilfall's separate mountain treatment; no height, collision, control-map, route or water-depth changes. Pair with water_dune_cover.json. Default off until production review.
data/config/water_dune_terrain.json._comment_bluff: Painted rocky banks blend out the dune replacement between normal Y 0.90 and 0.70, retaining installed mineral albedo, normals and roughness at full coverage. Gentle ground stays sand. Verified baked Sluice bank samples span 34-74 degrees; no terrain geometry or collision changes.
data/config/water_dune_terrain.json._comment_shadow: Gated terrain-only shadow caster offset in metres, limited to 0..0.10 and faded out at Veilfall. Native Gull Rest controlled receiver-01 comparison removed fine self-shadow bands at 0.05 while retaining the trainer contact shadow. Visual terrain/collision and global Sun bias are unchanged. Cross-island/day-night review remains required.
data/config/water_dune_terrain.json._reference: Inspected NPS Sleeping Bear Dunes photo: https://www.nps.gov/slbe/learn/photosmultimedia/index.htm (pale quartz sand, sparse sage/straw beach grass, dark damp waterline); direction only, no photographic pixels shipped.
